direct.description: Centered clue-to-card cosine similarity, the production baseline.

latentVocabularyWalk.description: Top-64 local clue-vocabulary concepts, with the strongest positive two-edge cosine product used for each card.

wordnetSenseBridge.description: Maximum cosine between separate WordNet sense-definition embeddings for the clue and card, calibrated back into operative score geometry with max(direct, concept - offset).

pairwiseCrossEncoder.description: Pinned local cross-encoders score each raw clue-card pair without WordNet evidence. Larger candidates use deterministic human-data samples before any promotion run.

boundedBridgeRerank.description: Direct BGE activates the existing WordNet expansion, then a local cross-encoder adds a capped adjustment within the top bridge shortlist.

hostedLlmReranker.reason: GPT-5.4 nano ranks six original public fixture boards with and without WordNet evidence. Hosted ranking remains ineligible for automatic local-first turns.

candidateScreen.reason: Current local bridge and comparison baseline.
Changes packaging and first-use work, not ranking quality, because it stores the same centered vectors used by the runtime gloss bridge.
Requires training from an input word-vector space and has no ready BGE-small-aligned artifact.
Uses a separate transformer sense space and would add a second large runtime model before Codenames-specific evidence.
The published sense embeddings are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Prior standalone evaluation improved human recall but failed Fun and transfer gates; its CC BY-SA artifact remains unsuitable for redistribution without review.
MiniLM and Mixedbread use full human data. BGE base and BGE v2-m3 use deterministic one-in-eight human samples after failing direct JOUST.
Its custom ONNX architecture was run on all six original fixtures. Direct ranking fails JOUST, while all-definition WordNet input repairs JOUST but loses targets on three other fixtures.
It clears all six original fixtures with and without WordNet, but CC BY-NC 4.0 and a 1.22 GB local asset block production.
A two-request GPT-5.4 nano fixture run cost $0.0008 under a $0.005 hard cap. Automatic turns must stay offline, bounded, and free per turn.

selected.rationale: Retain the runtime WordNet bridge. Mixedbread is the only production-eligible direct reranker that clears JOUST, but it trails WordNet on both full human datasets. Adding it after WordNet produces zero 20-board full-game deltas while adding a 95.9 MB cache and about 547 MB resident peak. Larger local models add more cost without stronger evidence, Jina is noncommercial, and hosted listwise ranking violates the offline automatic-turn boundary.
